title: Microphone check
description: A compact audio preflight reveals available input devices and a measured level meter.
useCase: Select a working input before entering a call.
interaction: Enable the microphone, choose a device, then mute or disconnect.
reducedMotion: The real level meter updates at four samples per second without tweening.
limitations: Requires an explicit permission grant and an available input device. Audio stays local and is not recorded or sent.
look: White rounded card on a pale grey-blue page: microphone icon, device dropdown, a row of thin grey meter bars and a full-width navy button.
motion: Once the microphone is enabled, 38 bars light from the left in proportion to the live RMS input level, sampled every 65 ms without tweening; muting zeroes it.
adapt: Sampling is the `setInterval` effect reading `getFloatTimeDomainData` from the `analyser` (gain `* 5`, period `reduced ? 250 : 65`); `.meter` renders 38 `data-on` bars. Device access lives in `connect` and `release`; replace the copy and palette.
